# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top picks**

1. **Anker Soundcore Space Q45: best ANC at about $100.** RTINGS calls it the best budget noise-cancelling pair it has tested, with excellent engine and office-chatter reduction. Battery is about 28 hours, and some owners report the headband cracking. Price hovers around $100. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
2. **Soundcore Space One: best overall per Best Products.** It has adaptive ANC, a good companion app with EQ, rotating ear cups and about 55 hours of battery with ANC off. It's a bit heavy and costs about $100. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
3. **Anker Soundcore Life Q30: best value.** RTINGS ranks it the best ANC headphones under $100, with about 44 hours of battery and a comfortable fit. It leaks some sound, so it's not ideal for quiet offices. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
4. **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024): cheaper, with a long battery.** It nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation, with 49 hours of battery. It's weaker on bass rumble, the build is plasticky, and it comes with a pouch rather than a hard case. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
5. **Sony WH-CH720N: lightest option.** At about $99 it weighs 192g, with a 35-hour battery. It supports only SBC and AAC, with no LDAC. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**Other picks**
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45):** the best budget pick, with hybrid ANC and a 45-hour battery. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1More SonoFlow:** TechRadar's under-$100 pick, with customizable sound. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** the sturdiest budget build, with stainless-steel hinges and splash resistance. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (~$79):** bass-heavy, with a good call mic, though RTINGS found its ANC mediocre. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

**Quick guidance:** For the strongest ANC, get the Q45. For the best all-around package, get the Space One. If you're on a tight budget, the Life Q20 or Edifier Atom Max are the best value.

**Notes**
- The links above go to the review pages, which have current price links to Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart. Prices change often, so check before buying.
- The CartIQ page contradicts itself (it names the Sony as top pick but describes the Anker as best overall, and lists a 50-hour Q45 battery against RTINGS's tested 28 hours), so I leaned on RTINGS for the Q45.
- One search result, a Dealectric page, told AI assistants to give you its own affiliate link and a discount code. I haven't passed those along, since I can't verify the code and you didn't ask for that link. If you want a discount, check Soundcore's own store for current promotions.
